summary: Special Exception approval required for data center uses in Industrial Park, General Industry and Mineral Resources-Heavy Industry districts. Reported effect: no by-right data center development anywhere in the county.

source.citation: Loudoun County project page; Piedmont Environmental Council alert, September 9 2026

notes: PEC describes it as ending the industry's 25-year ability to build without Board approval or public review
confidence_note: Adopted text not read. Effect described from a county project page and an advocacy alert.
